multi_stage_builds.name: Use Multi-Stage Builds
multi_stage_builds.description: Use multi-stage builds to reduce final image size
multi_stage_builds.implementation: Use separate FROM statements for build and runtime stages
multi_stage_builds.example:
FROM builder AS build
...
FROM alpine AS final
COPY --from=build /app /app

specific_version_tags.name: Use Specific Version Tags
specific_version_tags.description: Use specific version tags instead of 'latest'
specific_version_tags.implementation: FROM image:version instead of FROM image:latest
specific_version_tags.example: FROM ubuntu:22.04 instead of FROM ubuntu:latest

non_root_user.name: Run as Non-Root User
non_root_user.implementation: Add USER directive after creating user

layer_caching.name: Optimize Layer Caching
layer_caching.description: Order instructions to maximize cache hits
layer_caching.implementation: Copy dependency files first, then source code
layer_caching.example:
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .

clean_package_cache.name: Clean Package Cache
clean_package_cache.description: Remove package cache to reduce image size
clean_package_cache.implementation: Add cleanup commands in same RUN as install
